_doc: The one pin of gitleaks (SPECIFICATIONS section 3 tool table: gitleaks 8.30.1, MIT, CI only; NFR-14; P7-SCANS). Every place that runs gitleaks installs it through ci/gitleaks/install.ts from this file: the release archive named here, from the release URL, accepted only when its SHA-256 equals the value here (the values are the project's published checksums.txt for v8.30.1, https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_checksums.txt) and when the unpacked binary answers `gitleaks version` with exactly this version. No floating latest, no package-manager formula, no copy found on PATH. To move the pin, change version and every sha256 together, in 1 commit.
